Priyanka (release-lead): Quick announcement: we're compressing the release cadence tonight to clear a backlog of emergency fixes — freeze window 20:0098:00 UTC (12h) with a controlled hotfix lane at 23:0002:00 UTC. Please avoid non-urgent merges.
Owen (infra): Ack. Which services are allowed in the hotfix lane?
Priyanka (release-lead): Hotfix lane is limited to runtime, routing, and canary infra components (runtime, api-gateway, kv-cache). No schema, billing, or auth changes.
Luca (oncall): Escalation thresholds for hotfixes?
Priyanka (release-lead): If any hotfix causes p99 increase > 50% for 10m, auto-revert and page infra. Also, if errors > 0.7% for 5m, rollback and notify release lead.
Marisol (pm): I'll update the weekly changelog with a note: "Cadence compression + controlled hotfix lane for emergency fixes (ticket REL-827)" and ping impacted partners.
DeployBot: Action: freeze_applied by Priyanka on services [billing, auth, user-mgmt] at 20:03 UTC. Hotfix approval channel set to @Priyanka and @Owen.
Owen (infra): CI gates updated: hotfixes must include a short rollback plan in PR and be flagged `hotfix/approved` before merge.
Luca (oncall): I'll stand up additional synthetic checks on the hotfix targets and watch dashboards closely. Link: https://dash.internal.redwood/boards/release-hotfixes
Priyanka (release-lead): Thanks all. I'll post a mid-window status at 00:30 UTC and a final lift notice when we open the train. :white_check_mark:
